summary: ACP Holdings Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to announce two routine operational updates: the separate trading of its units into Class A ordinary shares and warrants effective May 28, 2026, and the partial forfeiture of founder shares following the expiration of the over-allotment option from its April 2026 IPO. The IPO of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 each generated $200M gross; 1,461,600 over-allotment units were also issued. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or activist event is involved. This is a standard SPAC post-IPO housekeeping filing with no special-situation implications.
